scope: EXPLORATORY validation; same first 32 predetermined images, batch8 FP32, two warmup batches and five passes; fresh worker; complete CLIP object loaded for both, not a stripped minimum-memory probe
caveats: GPU synchronized wall-clock includes CPU work, decoding and output transfer; excludes model load and receipt checks
OS file caches may be warm; hardware-specific batch8 observation, not interactive single-image latency
RAM peak includes model import/load and allocator retention; CUDA reserved is not device-wide usage
Feature latency includes actual feature branches used by each model; same encoder parameters, images, precision and hardware
